item.title: [News] Enabling a new model for healthcare with AI co-clinician
item.description: Google DeepMind is researching AI-augmented care through the development of an AI co-clinician. This effort aims to enable a new model for healthcare using AI.

item.title: [News] Four ways Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance
item.description: Google Research scientists have been using Empirical Research Assistance to explore various applications. This includes data mining and modeling.

item.title: [News] Unlocking human ambition to drive business growth with AI
item.description: Microsoft's Copilot and Agents are being integrated into tools people use daily, allowing organizations to unlock creativity and accelerate innovation with AI. This enables businesses to drive growth and reinvent their operations.

item.title: [News] Microsoft Sovereign Private Cloud scales to thousands of nodes with Azure Local
item.description: Microsoft has scaled Azure Local to support deployments of up to thousands of servers, allowing organizations to run larger workloads locally while maintaining control within their sovereign boundary.

item.title: [News] Announcing our partnership with the Republic of Korea
item.description: Google DeepMind has partnered with the Republic of Korea to accelerate scientific breakthroughs using frontier AI models. However, this development has little direct impact on an IT engineer's day-to-day work.
